notes: Nuxt: @bugsee/nuxt is a Nuxt module that launches the browser client (with the Vue error handler) and the Nitro server from one nuxt.config entry. The token is read from BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN, which Nuxt loads from .env when it reads the config (the wizard writes it there, git-ignored); set it in CI and hosting too. The wizard installs the adapter and hands you the exact wiring for the framework's own files instead of editing them; run it again after pasting and the step is reported as done. An application token is not a secret.
